verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent stack (Agent Cards, Agent Wallets, Agent Checkouts) is documented from the buyer/agent side. Nothing in the pack describes merchant-side settlement, payout, or reporting for agent-originated payments that would make them reconcilable like other channels. Payments-order webhooks and offramp bank payouts belong to separate general products and are not tied to agent payment reconciliation, and agent checkouts explicitly have "no webhooks in v1".

support.subject: As a merchant, agent-originated payments settle through documented payout and reporting flows, reconcilable like any other channel
